newsitem.title: UK: Lloyd's details syndicate capacity auction result.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's details syndicate capacity auction result.

text.p: Lloyd's of London on Thursday announced the result of the first auction of underwriting capacity for the 1998 underwriting year.
A total of 46.8 million stg of market capacity involving 102 syndicates underwriting this year was successfully auctioned at a total value of 2.4 million stg.
Subscription offers - offers to buy - totalled 417.7 million stg and tenders - offers to sell - totalled 115.5 million stg during the auction held 8-9 July.
The auction was the first held by Lloyd's using a fully electronic system.
Lloyd's said the system had brought many advantages including collecting and processing bids in an efficient and cost-effective way.
The auction is the first in a series of eight auctions being held from July to September. The second auction will be held 22-23 July.
